author: Times Radio
description:
WARNING: This episode contains descriptions some listeners may find distressing.

On episode 24 of the Trial of Russell Brand podcast, Rosamund Urwin speaks to one woman who has decided to waive her right to anonymity. 

Mia Latter was known as Alice in the Times and Sunday Times 2023 reporting. She had a relationship with Russell Brand in 2006 when she was 16 and he was 30. 

She alleges that during that relationship Brand was emotionally abusive, cruel, controlling – and that he orally raped her. Allegations Brand denied. 

Mia has decided to share her story so she can campaign for a staggered age of consent in the UK, restricting sexual activity between teenagers and those in their 30s or older. 

Read how Rosamund and Charlotte helped women expose Russell Brand.

Send us your questions: investigates.podcasts@thetimes.com 
If you, or someone you know, has been affected by the issues raised in this episode, the following organisations can help:
Rape Crisis England & Wales
NHS - Help
title: The Trial of Russell Brand | Day 24: I’m Alice
